name: Content
description: Keeps two posts going out every week.

brings: A table of every post, drafted and published
A draft every Tuesday and Thursday
The week's count in Pages, every Friday

how: Every post is a row in posts, from its draft to where it went out
A draft every Tuesday and Thursday, for its author to approve

outcome.sentence: Two posts go out every week.
outcome.measure: SELECT count(*) FROM posts WHERE published_at >= date_trunc('week', now())
